A jogosultság nem lehet algoritmus-tippe: Eligibility cannot be a generative guess. Fundor's deterministic rule engine emits exactly one of four explicit verdicts for every open call.
Minden hard szabály maradéktalanul telje: All hard criteria pass. No exclusionary conditions exist; project size, location, and industry code are valid.
A kemény szabályok stimmelnek, de teljes: Hard rules pass, but conditions must be resolved: co-financing verification, de minimis declaration, or tight window.
A rendszer nem találgat: rákérdez a hián: The system never guesses: it surfaces the question. Answering it updates your profile and recalculates all matches.
Legalább egy kemény kizáró szabály meghi: At least one hard exclusionary rule failed. The call is immediately ruled out, saving wasted administrative effort.

Hogyan működik a determinisztikus alkalm: How does deterministic eligibility screening work?
A motor deklaratív szabályokat értékel k: The engine evaluates declarative rules against your company data (headcount, industry code, closed financial years, investment goal, location). It never guesses: if a call excludes Budapest companies or requires farming, the system immediately filters it out rather than showing a deceptive score.
Mi a különbség az 5 pontozási faktor köz: What is the difference between the 5 scoring factors?
A Fundor Score öt súlyozott tényezőből é: The Fundor Score is synthesized from five weighted factors: Eligibility (35%), Project Fit (25%), Funding Size and project ratio (15%), Deadline & Timing (15%), and Feasibility & administrative burden (10%).
Mi történik, ha hiányzik egy adat a cégü: What happens if information is missing from our company profile?
Ha egy szükséges feltétel (például de mi: When a required field (such as past de minimis state aid) is unknown, the system refuses to guess: it issues an INSUFFICIENT DATA verdict. You can resolve the question in one click, instantly recalculating relevance across all related calls.
Nem. A Fundor döntéstámogató intelligenc: No. Fundor is decision-support intelligence: it reveals which calls are viable for your business and filters out guaranteed rejections. Final award decisions are made by governing authorities based on the quality of your submitted proposal.
